# 00000007694

**TIL-04 ★** — source: 242_离散几何II_镶嵌与铺砌.md

**English.** Definition: The topological entropy h_top of a translational tiling space (X,T) is the exponential growth rate of the pattern count N(L) along boxes of edge L. Conjecture: h_top=0 on X generated by a finite prototile set T if and only if X lifts to a factor of a substitution system; in particular, any minimal tiling space from a single prototile has zero entropy, while two prototiles can produce positive-entropy minimal systems. (zero-entropy substitution lifting)

**中文。** 定义：平移铺砌空间 (X,T) 的拓扑熵 h_top 定义为沿边长 L 方盒的图案数 N(L) 的指数增长率 lim (log N(L))/L^d。猜想：由有限 prototile 集 T 生成的 X 上 h_top=0 当且仅当 X 可被提升为某个替换系统的因子；特别地，任何单 prototile 生成的平移铺砌空间若极小则熵为零，而双 prototile 可产生正熵极小系统。
